title: Fix fractional minute clock formatting (08:4.3) and sub-minute relative timestamps in event-stream.ts

sections.what: Fix tickToTime() emitting decimal minute strings like 08:4.3 on fractional time_per_tick_minutes and update tickToRelative() so distinct sub-minute turns do not collapse to just now.
sections.why: static/js/event-stream.ts line 295 computes const m = total % 60 without Math.floor, producing invalid strings such as 08:4.3 whenever time_per_tick_minutes is fractional (e.g. 0.25 or 0.1 for rapid confrontation beats). Meanwhile tickToRelative() (lines 360-372) treats every diffMin < 1 (including multi-turn seconds-apart exchanges) as 'just now', whereas engine/tick_manager.py (lines 450-463) already calculates HH:MM:SS cleanly for fractional tick durations.
sections.how:
1. Update tickToTime() in static/js/event-stream.ts (lines 291-300) to match engine/tick_manager.py get_current_time() (lines 450-463): convert elapsed minutes cleanly into integer hours, floored integer minutes, and rounded/floored seconds (showing :SS only when fractional seconds exist or when formatted at sub-minute cadence).
2. Update tickToRelative() in static/js/event-stream.ts (lines 360-372) so positive intervals < 1 minute report '<N> seconds ago' when sub-minute ticks are active instead of collapsing everything > 0 ticks to 'just now' (reserving 'just now' for diffTicks === 0).
3. Rebuild TypeScript bundles (npm run build:ts) and add unit coverage for fractional tick formatting.
sections.verify:
1. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs with tests for tickToTime and tickToRelative under 0.25 and 0.1 minutes-per-tick settings.
2. Verify fractional outputs align with engine/tick_manager.py get_current_time().

acceptance.text: tickToTime() in static/js/event-stream.ts floors minute values and formats sub-minute seconds (matching engine/tick_manager.py get_current_time() HH:MM[:SS] semantics) so fractional time_per_tick_minutes never emits strings like 08:4.3.
tickToRelative() distinguishes sub-minute offsets (seconds ago or exact second deltas) instead of flattening every non-zero interval under one minute to just now.
JS unit tests cover integer and fractional time_per_tick_minutes (for example 0.25 and 0.1 minutes per tick) across tickToTime and tickToRelative.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Event Stream timestamps and Prompt I REMEMBER relative labels (static/js/event-stream.ts tickToTime and tickToRelative).

Current availability: tickToTime computes const m = total % 60 without Math.floor, producing decimal minutes such as 08:4.3 on fractional tick durations, while tickToRelative collapses all sub-minute diffs (< 1 min) to just now.

Manual verification steps:
1. Configure a scenario or setting with fractional time_per_tick_minutes (e.g. 0.25 = 15s per tick) and run several turns.
2. Inspect Event Stream tick headers and I REMEMBER memory prefixes.
   - expected: Timestamps display clean padded HH:MM or HH:MM:SS (e.g. 08:04:15), and distinct sub-minute events show distinct second offsets rather than identical just now labels.
